data.name: Disrupting Strike
data.description: As a full-round action, you may make one melee attack against each enemy adjacent to you.  If you hit, the attack deals no damage, but each enemy hit takes a -5 penalty to all melee and ranged damage rolls until the start of your next turn.  This blade skill may not be used with the mind bolt.
